software-development.title: Software Development & Engineering
software-development.desc: Custom design and development of websites, web and mobile applications tailored to your business needs.
software-development.audience: SMEs, institutions and start-ups that need a dependable business tool, website or app.
software-development.longDesc: We design and build custom digital solutions — websites, web and mobile applications — fully aligned with your business processes. From requirements analysis to production deployment, our engineering team delivers robust, scalable and high-performance solutions.
software-development.featureDesc: Every line of code is written to address your operational constraints and accelerate your digital growth.
software-development.scopeIntro: We turn ideas into products that are fast, reliable, and ready to scale with your business.

scopeItems.title: Websites
scopeItems.description: Landing pages, marketing websites, and conversion-focused business websites designed for visibility and growth.

scopeItems.title: Web applications
scopeItems.description: Dashboards, portals, SaaS products, and internal tools built for daily operations and automation.

scopeItems.title: Mobile apps (iOS & Android)
scopeItems.description: Native or cross-platform applications designed for customer engagement, field teams, or on-the-go workflows.

scopeItems.title: APIs & integrations
scopeItems.description: Secure integrations with your CRM, ERP, payment systems, analytics tools, and third-party services.

scopeItems.title: Maintenance & evolution
scopeItems.description: Ongoing improvements, performance tuning, and feature rollouts to keep your product competitive.

software-development.heroSubtitle: Fast, modern digital products that look sharp and perform flawlessly.
software-development.heroDescription: From polished websites to powerful web and mobile apps, we shape technical solutions around your business goals, your users, and your growth plan.
software-development.whyUsIntro: We combine product thinking, design discipline, and engineering execution to build software that feels effortless for your users and reliable for your business.
whyUsItems: We build for performance, scalability, and long-term maintainability.
We translate business goals into clear product features and clean technical decisions.
We ensure your solution is ready for growth, integrations, and future upgrades.

social-media-management.title: Social Media Management
social-media-management.desc: Strategy, content and optimisation across your social channels to strengthen your online visibility.
social-media-management.audience: Brands, retailers and organisations that want a consistent, well-managed online presence.
social-media-management.longDesc: We build a coherent, engaging social presence for your brand. From content creation to community management and performance analysis, we put targeted actions in place to maximise your digital impact.
social-media-management.featureDesc: We help you build lasting relationships with your customers through relevant content and genuine interaction.

integration-solutions.title: Solution Integration
integration-solutions.desc: Connecting your business software  ERP, CRM and third-party tools  into one unified information system.
integration-solutions.audience: Organisations whose business tools do not yet talk to one another.
integration-solutions.longDesc: We deploy and interconnect your business software  ERP, CRM, SaaS platforms and third-party tools — into a single unified digital ecosystem. No more data silos: your teams work from information that flows freely, centralised and reliable.
integration-solutions.featureDesc: We connect your existing tools so they talk to each other transparently, cutting errors and operational time loss.

licences-editeurs.title: Software Licensing
licences-editeurs.desc: Advice, procurement and optimised management of software licences for businesses and institutions.
licences-editeurs.audience: Companies and public bodies that need to equip their workstations and stay on top of their licences.
licences-editeurs.longDesc: We advise businesses and institutions on the purchase and management of their software licences. We help you stay compliant, control costs and access the best commercial terms.
process: Audit of the existing software estate
licences-editeurs.featureDesc: We help you choose, buy and manage your Microsoft, Oracle, Adobe and other major-vendor licences.

support-infogerance.title: Support & Managed Services
support-infogerance.desc: Proactive monitoring and technical assistance that keep your systems performing without interruption.
support-infogerance.audience: Organisations with no in-house IT team, or whose team needs day-to-day reinforcement.
support-infogerance.longDesc: Our team keeps your infrastructure and applications operational. With continuous monitoring, responsive assistance and on-site intervention, we work to keep your information system available and performing.
support-infogerance.featureDesc: We take on your entire IT operation so you can focus on your core business with complete peace of mind.

formation-accompagnement.title: Training & Change Management
formation-accompagnement.desc: Building your teams' skills and guiding change so your new tools are genuinely adopted.
formation-accompagnement.audience: Teams that have just adopted a new tool and need to make it part of how they work.
formation-accompagnement.longDesc: Even the best tool is worthless without users who have mastered it. We design tailored training programmes and guide your teams through change, so your new digital solutions are adopted quickly, effectively and for the long term.
formation-accompagnement.featureTitle: The human factor at the heart of digital
formation-accompagnement.featureDesc: We put the end user at the centre of every project, so the technology genuinely serves your teams and your goals.

transformation-digitale.title: Digital Transformation Consulting
transformation-digitale.desc: Strategic guidance through your digital transition, from first thinking to full implementation.
transformation-digitale.audience: Leaders who want a clear roadmap before investing in technology.
transformation-digitale.longDesc: Digital transformation is a journey, not a destination. We guide leaders and their teams in defining a digital roadmap, identifying where the value lies, and progressively implementing solutions suited to their sector and their digital maturity.
transformation-digitale.featureDesc: We help you ask the right questions before choosing the right tools, for a lasting transformation that creates real business value.

cybersecurite-conformite.title: Cybersecurity & Compliance
cybersecurite-conformite.desc: Security audits, compliance with Burkina Faso's data-protection law and the GDPR, and protection of your sensitive data.
cybersecurite-conformite.audience: Organisations that handle sensitive data or have a compliance requirement to meet.
cybersecurite-conformite.longDesc: With cyber threats on the rise, protecting your information system is no longer optional. We carry out in-depth security audits, implement robust protection policies, and guide you towards compliance with the regulations that apply to you: Burkina Faso's data-protection law and the GDPR.
cybersecurite-conformite.featureDesc: We build security best practice into every stage of your projects, for an information system resilient to today's threats and tomorrow's.

cloud-hebergement.title: Cloud & Hosting
cloud-hebergement.desc: Cloud migration and infrastructure management on AWS, Azure and Google Cloud for a more agile IT.
cloud-hebergement.audience: Companies with ageing infrastructure, or whose needs vary from one month to the next.
cloud-hebergement.longDesc: We support businesses through their migration to the cloud and the management of their infrastructure on AWS, Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform. Our approach aims for a controlled, secure transition, optimised for lower costs and maximum agility.
benefits: Secure cloud migration with minimal downtime
cloud-hebergement.featureTitle: Agile IT that serves your growth
cloud-hebergement.featureDesc: Our team deploys on AWS, Azure and GCP and helps you get the most out of the cloud while keeping your costs and your security under control.

platforms.name: Amazon Web Services
platforms.insight: Scalable infrastructure and managed services to host and grow your business applications with confidence.

platforms.name: Microsoft Azure
platforms.insight: The natural cloud for Microsoft environments, with native integration into Office 365 and Active Directory.

platforms.name: Google Cloud Platform
platforms.insight: Leading-edge infrastructure for data, AI and cloud-native projects that demand performance and innovation.

intelligence-artificielle.title: Applied Artificial Intelligence
intelligence-artificielle.desc: AI solutions : chatbots, automation and document processing , integrated to boost your team's productivity.
intelligence-artificielle.audience: Teams spending too much time on repetitive tasks or on processing documents.
intelligence-artificielle.longDesc: Artificial intelligence is changing how work gets done. We embed concrete, operational AI into your business processes: intelligent conversational agents, automation of repetitive tasks, and intelligent document processing that frees up your teams' potential.
intelligence-artificielle.featureTitle: AI applied to the real world
intelligence-artificielle.featureDesc: We don't sell AI for its own sake — we identify the high-impact use cases in your organisation and deploy solutions that genuinely make a difference.

meta.title: About us
meta.description: Digital Station: an IT services, consulting and engineering company founded in 2018 in Ouagadougou. Our mission, our values and our team.

hero.intro: Digital Station was born from a simple conviction: African businesses deserve technology partners who understand their human stakes as well as their technical challenges.

mission.title: We are the technology <accent>partner</accent> you have been waiting for.
mission.body1: Digital Station supports businesses and institutions across West Africa through their digital transformation. From custom software engineering to continuous managed services, strategic consulting and cybersecurity, we offer a complete ecosystem of services led by a team of committed experts.
mission.body2: Our approach rests on three pillars: technical excellence, mutual trust, and an obsession with concrete results.

excellence.title: Operational excellence
excellence.desc: We aim for excellence in every delivery, with no compromise on quality. Every line of code counts.

innovation.title: Continuous innovation
innovation.desc: We anticipate technological shifts to offer forward-looking solutions suited to the African market.

partnership.title: Lasting partnership
partnership.desc: Our clients are partners, not transactions. We build relationships for the long term.

local.title: Global standards, local roots
local.desc: International standards with a deep understanding of local realities and needs in Burkina Faso.

items.2018: Digital Station founded in Burkina Faso

team.title: Experts who <accent>care</accent>
team.body: Our strength lies in a multidisciplinary team. Developers, solution architects, cybersecurity specialists and strategy consultants work together to turn your ambitions into working technology.

director.name: Landry P. KABORE
director.sectionTitle: A word from the Managing Director
director.pillarsTitle: The pillars of our growth strategy
director.message: Technology is not an end in itself. It is a lever in the service of human ambition. Since we started in 2018 our conviction has not changed: treat every client as a long-term partner, deliver technical excellence, and never lose sight of what actually matters to them. In Burkina Faso and across West Africa, we are building tomorrow's digital, one project at a time.

vision.title: Vision 2030
vision.desc: To become the IT reference in West Africa

process.title: How we <accent>work.</accent>
process.intro: Whatever the engagement, we follow the same five phases. It is what makes our timelines realistic and our deliveries predictable.
process.footnote: Each service adapts these phases to its own technical demands.

audit.title: Audit & scoping
audit.desc: We start from what exists: your processes, your tools, your constraints. Nothing is proposed before we understand what already works.

design.title: Design
design.desc: Architecture, mockups and technology choices. You approve the direction before the first line of code is written.

build.title: Build
build.desc: Frequent, iterative releases. You watch the product take shape rather than waiting for one big delivery.

test.title: Testing & sign-off
test.desc: Every release is tested, then signed off with you before it goes live. This is where the product's reliability is decided.

deliver.title: Deploy & support
deliver.desc: Going live, training your teams, then ongoing monitoring and improvements.

privacy.metaDescription: How Digital Station collects, uses and protects your personal data.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy.
privacy.contactBody: For any question about your personal data, or to exercise your rights, write to us at

collection.title: Data we collect
collection.body: We collect only what is needed to provide our services: the details you send us through our contact form (name, email address, phone number, description of your project), together with anonymous usage data used to improve the site.

usage.title: How we use it
usage.body: Your data is used solely to answer your enquiry, to send you a proposal, and to manage the work that follows. It is not used for any other purpose without your prior agreement.

sharing.title: Sharing with third parties
sharing.body: We do not sell or rent your personal data. It may be processed by our technical providers (hosting, email delivery) only as far as the site requires, and under a confidentiality undertaking.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.body: Enquiries received through the contact form are kept for as long as needed to handle your request and any commercial relationship that follows, then archived or deleted.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You have the right to access, correct, erase, restrict and object to the processing of your personal data, as well as the right to data portability. Requests are handled promptly.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: This site does not set any cookies. Your theme preference is stored locally in your browser (localStorage) and your language is carried in the page address. You can clear this data at any time from your browser settings.

security.title: Security
security.body: Traffic to and from this site is encrypted. We apply appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your data against unauthorised access, alteration or disclosure.

services.title: Our services
services.body: Digital Station provides IT consulting, engineering and integration services. The scope, timeline and deliverables of each engagement are set out in the corresponding proposal and contract.

intellectual.title: Intellectual property
intellectual.body: The content of this site : text, imagery, trade marks and logos belongs to Digital Station. Ownership of deliverables produced during an engagement is defined by the contract agreed with the client.

obligations.title: Client responsibilities
obligations.body: Delivering our work depends on receiving the information, access and approvals we need within reasonable timeframes. Delays attributable to these may shift the agreed schedule.

liability.title: Liability
liability.body: We commit the means necessary to deliver our services properly. We are not liable for indirect losses, nor for interruptions caused by third-party services or by circumstances outside our control.

law.title: Governing law
law.body: These terms are governed by the law of Burkina Faso. In the event of a dispute, the parties will seek an amicable resolution before commencing proceedings.
